lines: 2026 Iran war 2026 Iran war ceasefire Iran and the United Arab Emirates sign a joint statement that calls for restraint in the war. Additionally, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian meets with Abu Dhabi ruler Khaled bin Mohamed Al Nahyan at the BRICS summit, the highest profile meeting between the two countries since the war started on February 28. (Al-Monitor) (Hindustan Times)

2026 Iranian strikes on Jordan, China in the 2026 Iran war The Wall Street Journal reports that Iran has received Chinese satellite images before launching a July 17 strike on the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan that killed three United States Army soldiers. (Arab News)

Russo-Ukrainian war Zaporizhzhia strikes, Odesa strikes, Kryvyi Rih strikes Russian drone strikes across Ukraine kill eight civilians, including two people in Zaporizhzhia, two people at a grocery store in Zhytomyr, one person in Kryvyi Rih, while a "massive attack" targeting the Port of Odesa and surrounding areas wounds at least 28 people. (AP)
Eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war A Russian drone strikes a civilian vehicle in Kramatorsk, Donetsk Oblast, killing three people. (AP)
Rukidi IV, the late king of Uganda's Tooro Kingdom, is buried. (Reuters)

MV June Aster ship fire The Philippine coast guard confirms that 41 more bodies have been discovered aboard the burned vessel MV June Aster off Coron, Palawan, bringing the death toll from the fire to 76. (AFP via Philippine Daily Inquirer)

2026 Atlantic hurricane season The Atlantic hurricane season reaches a 103-day record in the satellite era without a major hurricane after the season started on June 1, the first since 1941, with the El Niño in the Pacific Ocean being a big factor. (The New York Times) (USA Today) (CNN)

North Korean missile tests North Korea launches a series of SRBM missile tests from Wonsan in response to trilateral Freedom Edge military drills conducted by the United States, South Korea, and Japan. (Korea JoongAng Daily)
Cléon derailment French officials investigate if the derailment was caused by sabotage after a fragment of rail was found on the tracks. (BBC) (RTÉ) (France 24)

Several residents are arrested after riots erupted yesterday in Kobani, Syria, over the murder of a Kurdish citizen that was blamed on an Arab man, while a prison riot at Kobani prison leaves seven inmates dead. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports the violence erupted over plans to transfer some prisoners to another prison in Aleppo. (ABC News) (AP) (ABC News)

Protests against Donald Trump Protests against the 2026 Iran war, Gaza war protests, Protests against the second Trump administration Thousands of demonstrators gather in Dublin, Ireland, against U.S. president Donald Trump's visit to the country and protest against his role in the wars in Iran and Gaza. (Irish Times)
